enterprise-registration.name: Enterprise registration
enterprise-registration.aka: Sole proprietorship · business in your own name
enterprise-registration.summary: Register a business in your own name (a sole proprietorship) so you can trade legally, open a business bank account and get a TIN. We check your details, complete the RDB registration for you and send you the certificate.
requirements: A Rwandan national ID, or a passport and residence permit
The name and activity of your business
Where the business operates (district, sector, cell)

documents.name: National ID
documents.detail: Clear photo of both sides, or the passport data page

documents.name: Proof of business address
documents.detail: Lease or a letter from the owner, if you have one

steps.title: You start the request
steps.body: Answer a few short questions. Takes about 3 minutes.

steps.title: We check your documents
steps.body: Your agent confirms everything is correct, usually within 2 working hours.

steps.title: You approve the fees
steps.body: You see the official fee and our fee separately, then pay by MoMo or Airtel Money.

steps.title: We submit via RDB
steps.body: We submit through the official channel and share the official reference number with you.

steps.title: RDB processes it
steps.body: The institution reviews and decides. We follow up if it takes longer than usual.

steps.title: You receive the result
steps.body: Delivered to your portal and WhatsApp, with official receipts.
